abnormal-command-exit-runtime.description: Runtime in milliseconds below which a process exit is treated as abnormal, showing an error message. On Linux this must be paired with a non-zero exit code.

adjust-box-thickness.description: Adjustment to box drawing character thickness.

adjust-cell-height.description: Adjustment to cell height in pixels or percentage.

adjust-cell-width.description: Adjustment to cell width in pixels or percentage.

adjust-cursor-thickness.description: Adjustment to cursor thickness for bar/outlined cursors.

adjust-font-baseline.description: Adjustment to font baseline. Positive = UP, negative = DOWN.

adjust-icon-height.description: Adjustment to icon height. Default is 1.2x capital letter height.

adjust-underline-position.description: Adjustment to underline position. Positive = DOWN, negative = UP.

adjust-underline-thickness.description: Adjustment to underline thickness. Minimum clamped to 1px.

alpha-blending.description: Configuration for alpha blending in different colour spaces. Affects text and image transparency rendering.

app-notifications.description: Application notifications to enable. Comma-separated list; prefix a feature with no- to disable, or use true/false to toggle all. GTK only.

async-backend.description: Low-level async IO backend. Most users should leave this as auto.

background.description: Background colour of the terminal window.

background-blur.description: Background blur intensity. Boolean or number 0-255. Ignored on some compositors.

background-image.description: Path to background image. PNG or JPEG only.

background-image-fit.description: How to fit the background image.

background-image-opacity.description: Opacity of background image, relative to background-opacity.

background-image-repeat.description: Whether to repeat the background image.

background-opacity.description: Background opacity. Values outside 0-1 are clamped.

background-opacity-cells.description: Apply opacity to cells with explicit background colour.

bell-audio-path.description: Path to audio file for bell sound. Relative paths are resolved from the config file directory.

bell-audio-volume.description: Volume for bell audio, relative to system volume. 0.0 = silent, 1.0 = maximum.

bell-features.description: Bell features to enable. Comma-separated list; prefix a feature with no- to disable, or use true/false to toggle all.

bold-color.description: Colour for bold text. Can be a colour value (e.g. #RRGGBB) or bright to use bright palette colours.

bold-is-bright.description: Whether bold text uses bright colours.
bold-is-bright.deprecated: Deprecated since 1.2. Use bold-color = bright instead.

click-repeat-interval.description: Interval for click repeat detection in milliseconds. 0 = platform default.

clipboard-codepoint-map.description: Map Unicode codepoints to replacements when copying to clipboard. Format: U+XXXX=U+YYYY or U+XXXX=text.

clipboard-paste-bracketed-safe.description: Whether to use safe bracketed paste mode.

clipboard-read.description: Whether to allow reading from clipboard.

clipboard-trim-trailing-spaces.description: Whether to trim trailing spaces when copying.

clipboard-write.description: Whether to allow writing to clipboard.

clipboard-write-limit-bytes.description: Maximum size in bytes of a single clipboard write via the Kitty clipboard protocol (OSC 5522). Does not apply to OSC 52. Defaults to 64 MiB. Use 'unlimited' to remove the limit, or 0 to reject every non-empty write.

command.description: Command to run in the terminal. Supports arguments.

command-palette-entry.description: Custom command palette entry. Format: title:X,action:Y,description:Z.

config-default-files.description: Whether to load default configuration files. CLI-only.

config-file.description: Path to additional configuration file. Prefix with ? to suppress errors if missing.

confirm-close-surface.description: Whether to confirm before closing surfaces.

copy-on-select.description: Whether to automatically copy selected text to the clipboard. 'primary' targets the selection clipboard (Linux only), 'clipboard' the system clipboard, 'both' targets both. 'true' and 'false' are legacy aliases kept for backwards compatibility: 'true' means primary on Linux and clipboard on macOS, 'false' means none.

cursor-click-to-move.description: Whether clicking moves the cursor. Requires shell integration.

cursor-color.description: Colour of the cursor. Special values: cell-foreground, cell-background.

cursor-invert-fg-bg.description: Whether to invert foreground and background colours for cursor.
cursor-invert-fg-bg.deprecated: Deprecated since 1.2. Use cursor-color = cell-foreground and cursor-text = cell-background instead.

cursor-style-blink.description: Whether the cursor should blink. Unset follows DEC mode 12.

cursor-text.description: Text colour under the cursor. Special values: cell-foreground, cell-background.

custom-shader.description: Path to custom GLSL shader file.

drag-handle.description: When drag handles are shown over splits, allowing splits to be rearranged with the mouse. 'auto' shows the handle on Linux only when two or more splits exist, and on macOS whenever hovered outside single-split fullscreen.

env.description: Set environment variable. Format: KEY=VALUE. Empty value removes key.

faint-opacity.description: Opacity of faint (dim) text. 0.0 = transparent, 1.0 = fully opaque.

focus-follows-mouse.description: Whether focus follows mouse pointer in multi-pane windows.

font-codepoint-map.description: Map codepoint ranges to specific fonts.

font-family.description: Font family for regular text. Can be specified multiple times for fallbacks.

font-family-bold-italic.description: Font family for bold italic text.

font-shaping-break.description: Where to break text shaping runs. Comma-separated list; prefix a feature with no- to disable, or use true/false to toggle all.

font-style-bold.description: Font style for bold text. Set to false to disable.

font-style-bold-italic.description: Font style for bold italic text. Set to false to disable.

font-style-italic.description: Font style for italic text. Set to false to disable.

font-synthetic-style.description: Whether to use synthetic font styles when the font doesn't provide them. Comma-separated list; prefix a style with no- to disable, or use true/false to toggle all.

font-thicken.description: Whether to thicken fonts for better readability.

font-variation.description: Font variation axis settings for variable fonts.

font-variation-bold.description: Font variation axis settings for bold text.

font-variation-bold-italic.description: Font variation axis settings for bold italic text.

font-variation-italic.description: Font variation axis settings for italic text.

foreground.description: Foreground (text) colour of the terminal window.

freetype-load-flags.description: FreeType font loading flags. Comma-separated list; prefix a flag with no- to disable, or use true/false to toggle all.

fullscreen.description: Whether to start in fullscreen mode. Non-native variants use a custom fullscreen implementation.

gtk-adwaita.description: Whether to use Adwaita theme in GTK.
gtk-adwaita.deprecated: Removed. Ghostty now has a hard dependency on libadwaita.

gtk-custom-css.description: Path to custom CSS file for GTK.

gtk-gsk-renderer.description: GSK renderer to use in GTK.
gtk-gsk-renderer.deprecated: Removed. No longer a configurable option.

gtk-horizontal-tab-scroll.description: Whether two-finger horizontal scrolling on a touchpad switches between tabs.

gtk-opengl-debug.description: Whether to enable OpenGL debugging in GTK.

gtk-single-instance.description: Whether to use single instance mode in GTK. detect uses desktop environment settings.

gtk-titlebar.description: Whether to show titlebar in GTK.

gtk-titlebar-hide-when-maximized.description: Whether to hide titlebar when maximised in GTK.

gtk-titlebar-style.description: Style of the GTK titlebar. tabs merges the tab bar into the titlebar.

gtk-toolbar-style.description: Appearance of the GTK top and bottom toolbar bars.

gtk-wide-tabs.description: Whether to use wide tabs in GTK.

image-storage-limit.description: Limit for image storage in bytes. Max 4GiB, 0 = disabled.

initial-command.description: Initial command for first terminal only.

initial-window.description: Whether to create initial window on startup.

input.description: Input data to send to terminal. Formats: raw:string, path:filepath.

key-remap.description: Remap modifier keys within Ghostty. Format: source=target. Can be repeated for multiple remaps.

keybind.description: Keyboard binding. Format: [prefix:]trigger=action[:param]. Use keybind=clear to remove all defaults.

language.description: Override the GUI language. Must include encoding (e.g. de_DE.UTF-8). Cannot be reloaded at runtime. GTK only.

link.description: Custom regex pattern matching for URLs/text. Format: regex:PATTERN action:ACTION.

link-osc8.description: Enable hyperlinks created with the OSC 8 escape sequence. When disabled, OSC 8 hyperlinks are not highlighted, previewed, copied, or opened. Does not affect URL matching controlled by link-url.

link-url.description: Whether to enable URL link detection.

linux-cgroup-hard-fail.description: Whether to hard fail on Linux cgroup errors.

macos-applescript.description: Whether Ghostty exposes and handles the built-in AppleScript dictionary on macOS. If false, all AppleScript interactions are disabled, including AppleScript commands and object lookup for windows, tabs, and terminals.

macos-custom-icon.description: Path to a custom app icon file. Supports PNG, JPEG, and ICNS formats.

macos-dock-drop-behavior.description: Behaviour when dropping a file or folder onto the Ghostty dock icon.

macos-hidden.description: Whether to hide the macOS app from the dock and app switcher.

macos-icon-frame.description: Frame material for custom macOS icon.

macos-icon-ghost-color.description: Ghost colour for custom macOS icon.

macos-icon-screen-color.description: Screen colour for custom macOS icon.

macos-non-native-fullscreen.description: Whether to use non-native fullscreen on macOS.

macos-option-as-alt.description: Whether to treat option key as alt. Use left/right to enable for only one key.

macos-secure-input-indication.description: Whether to show secure input indication.

macos-shortcuts.description: Whether macOS Shortcuts are allowed to control Ghostty.

macos-titlebar-proxy-icon.description: Whether to show proxy icon in titlebar.

macos-window-buttons.description: Whether the macOS window buttons (traffic lights) are visible.

maximize.description: Whether to maximise the window on startup.

middle-click-action.description: Action taken when the user middle-clicks the terminal surface. 'primary-paste' pastes from the selection clipboard on Linux and does nothing on macOS, 'clipboard-paste' pastes from the standard clipboard, 'ignore' does nothing.

minimum-contrast.description: Minimum contrast ratio for text readability (WCAG 2.0 standard).

mouse-hide-while-typing.description: Whether to hide mouse cursor while typing.

mouse-reporting.description: Whether to report mouse events to terminal applications. Can be toggled with toggle_mouse_reporting keybind.

mouse-scroll-multiplier.description: Scroll speed multiplier for mouse wheel.

notify-on-command-finish.description: When to send notifications after a command finishes. Requires shell integration or OSC 133.

notify-on-command-finish-action.description: How to notify when a command finishes. Comma-separated list; prefix an action with no- to disable, or use true/false to toggle all.

notify-on-command-finish-after.description: Minimum command runtime before a finish notification is sent. Default is 5 seconds.

palette.description: Set colours in the 256-colour palette. Format: N=colour where N is 0-255.

palette-generate.description: Whether to auto-generate the extended 256-colour palette (indices 16-255) from the base 16 ANSI colours.

palette-harmonious.description: Invert generated palette colour order for better light/dark mode support. Requires palette-generate.

progress-style.description: Whether applications can show graphical progress bars via the ConEmu OSC 9;4 escape sequence. If false, progress bar sequences are silently ignored.

quick-terminal-animation-duration.description: Duration of quick terminal animation in seconds. 0 = disabled.

quick-terminal-autohide.description: Whether to auto-hide quick terminal when losing focus.

quick-terminal-keyboard-interactivity.description: Keyboard interactivity mode for quick terminal.

quick-terminal-screen.description: Screen to show quick terminal on.

quick-terminal-size.description: Size of quick terminal. Format: percentage, pixels, or both.

quick-terminal-space-behavior.description: Behaviour of quick terminal in spaces/desktops.

quit-after-last-window-closed.description: Whether to quit after last window is closed.

quit-after-last-window-closed-delay.description: Delay before quitting after last window closed. Minimum 1s.

scroll-to-bottom.description: When to scroll to bottom automatically. Comma-separated list; prefix a trigger with no- to disable, or use true/false to toggle all.

scrollback-compression.description: Whether to compress scrollback pages while the terminal is idle. Reduces physical memory usage without changing how much history is retained.

scrollback-limit.description: Size of the scrollback buffer in bytes. Renamed upstream; the value is forwarded to scrollback-limit-bytes.

scrollback-limit-bytes.description: Size of the scrollback buffer in bytes, per terminal surface, including the active screen. Defaults to 50 MB. Use 'unlimited' to remove the byte limit. If scrollback-limit-lines is also set, the first limit reached wins.

scrollback-limit-lines.description: Maximum number of scrollback lines to retain, excluding the active screen. Soft-wrapped lines count as multiple lines. The limit is an estimate as Ghostty trims whole pages. Defaults to 'unlimited'.

search-background.description: Background colour for non-focused search matches. Special values: cell-foreground, cell-background.

search-foreground.description: Foreground colour for non-focused search matches. Special values: cell-foreground, cell-background.

search-selected-background.description: Background colour for the currently focused search match. Special values: cell-foreground, cell-background.

search-selected-foreground.description: Foreground colour for the currently focused search match. Special values: cell-foreground, cell-background.

selection-background.description: Background colour for selected text. Special values: cell-foreground, cell-background.

selection-clear-on-copy.description: Whether to clear selection after copying.

selection-clear-on-typing.description: Whether to clear selection when typing.

selection-foreground.description: Text colour for selected text. Special values: cell-foreground, cell-background.

selection-invert-fg-bg.description: Whether to invert foreground and background colours for selection.
selection-invert-fg-bg.deprecated: Deprecated since 1.2. Use selection-foreground = cell-foreground and selection-background = cell-background instead.

selection-word-chars.description: Characters that mark word boundaries for double-click selection. Each character becomes a boundary.

shell-integration-features.description: Shell integration features to enable/disable. Comma-separated list; prefix a feature with no- to disable, or use true/false to toggle all.

split-divider-color.description: Colour of split dividers. Auto-chosen if not set.

split-inherit-working-directory.description: Whether new split panes inherit the working directory of the focused split.

split-preserve-zoom.description: When to preserve zoomed split state. Use navigation to keep zoom when switching splits. Prefix with no- to disable, or use true/false to toggle all.

tab-inherit-working-directory.description: Whether new tabs inherit the working directory of the focused tab.

theme.description: Built-in theme name, custom theme path, or light/dark combination.

title.description: Force window title. Spaces hide the title.

title-report.description: Whether to allow title reporting (security risk).

unfocused-split-fill.description: Fill colour for unfocused splits. Defaults to background.

vt-kam-allowed.description: Whether VT KAM sequence is allowed.

wait-after-command.description: Keep terminal open after command exits.

window-height.description: Initial window height in cells. Minimum 4.

window-inherit-font-size.description: Whether new windows inherit the font size.

window-inherit-working-directory.description: Whether new windows inherit the working directory.

window-padding-balance.description: Whether to balance extra padding across edges.

window-padding-color.description: Colour of the window padding area.

window-padding-x.description: Horizontal padding in points. Format: single value or left,right.

window-padding-y.description: Vertical padding in points. Format: single value or top,bottom.

window-position-x.description: Initial window X position in pixels.

window-position-y.description: Initial window Y position in pixels.

window-save-state.description: Whether to save window state between sessions.

window-show-tab-bar.description: When to show the tab bar.

window-step-resize.description: Whether to resize in cell-sized increments.

window-titlebar-background.description: Background colour of window titlebar. Requires window-theme = ghostty.

window-titlebar-foreground.description: Foreground colour of window titlebar. Requires window-theme = ghostty.

window-width.description: Initial window width in cells. Minimum 10.

working-directory.description: Initial working directory. Special values: home, inherit.

duration.description: Duration with optional unit (y, d, h, m, s, ms, us, ns)
